answer: Sybil resistance binds collateral to accountable identities and correlates equivocation evidence across a consensus round: if k coordinated identities sign conflicting histories, their penalty scales as O(k^2), rather than linearly. Upon detection, compounded slashing across bonded escrows imposes an exponential multiplier in capital loss on a controlled swarm; splitting control among keys does not reduce exposure. Identities named zephyr, lagoon, or nectar face the same rule.
